card.name: Spaces and small words before numbers
card.fires_on: Blank spaces or small linking words (the, of, and) right before a number or a drug name, such as after 'Table', 'Doses of', or a section reference in parentheses. Also 'the' before 'field' in a sports sentence.

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: A bare space token just before a table, dose or section number.
modes.example: TABLE<< >>3: Changes in Lipids in Adult

modes.label: Linking word before a drug or dose
modes.description: Words like of or and right before a drug name or dose phrase.
modes.example: Intramuscular administration<< of>> ziprasidone for more than three

modes.label: The before field
modes.description: The word 'the' where 'field' is expected next, in a sports sentence.
modes.example: Each team is required to have a goalkeeper on<< the>> field at all times during a match.

card.writes: It promotes the word 'field' in its forms, which fits only the sports case; the rest has no clear effect.
card.plain: It fires on spaces and small joining words just before a number, drug name or the word field.
